tagline: Global leader in meal kits and ready-to-eat food solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The Ready-to-Eat (RTE) segment is the primary current growth driver, with y-o-y growth of 56%, more than offsetting the decline in meal kit revenues. This is a key strategic transformation toward a digital FMCG model.

kpis.name: Ready-to-Eat Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the ready-to-eat product category, such as Factor.
kpis.description: RTE revenue reached €496M in Q1 2024, versus €322M one year prior, representing 56% y-o-y growth.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth in the RTE segment

kpis.name: Meal Kit Revenue
kpis.description: The meal kit segment saw revenue decline to €1,559M in Q1 2024 from €1,687M in Q1 2023, due to lower demand.
kpis.signal: Temporary deceleration of the historic core business

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: The group achieved revenue of €2,073.5M in Q1 2024, growing 3.8% at constant currency versus €2,016.1M in Q1 2023.

kpis.name: Adjusted AEBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating results, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: AEBITDA reached €16.8M in Q1 2024 versus €66.1M one year prior, impacted by RTE segment industrialization costs and elevated Q1 seasonal marketing expenses.
kpis.signal: Margin compression linked to RTE launch and Q1 marketing seasonality

kpis.name: AEBITDA Margin
kpis.explanation: AEBITDA expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: AEBITDA margin fell to 0.8% in Q1 2024 versus 3.3% in Q1 2023, driven by RTE launch costs and elevated Q1 marketing seasonality: HelloFresh historically records seasonally elevated marketing spend in Q1.
kpis.signal: Temporary margin pressure from Q1 marketing seasonality and RTE ramp-up

kpis.name: Average Order Value
kpis.explanation: Average amount spent per order, excluding retail sales, at constant currency.
kpis.description: AOV at constant currency reached €65.2 in Q1 2024 versus €61.2 one year prior, supported by product incentives and improved customer value proposition.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in average customer basket

kpis.name: Order Count
kpis.explanation: Total number of orders placed during the period.
kpis.description: The group processed 31.98 million orders in Q1 2024 versus 32.82 million in Q1 2023, a decline of 2.6%.
kpis.signal: Slight volume contraction despite revenue growth

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €2.63B in the most recent year

kpis.name: RTE Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total revenue sourced from the Ready-to-Eat category.
kpis.description: RTE revenue share of total increased to approximately 24% in Q1 2024 (496/2,073.5 = 23.9%), versus approximately 16% in Q1 2023 (322/2,016.1 = 15.98%), an increase of 8 percentage points.

kpis.name: RTE International Launches
kpis.explanation: Number of new countries where Factor is launched during the period.
kpis.description: HelloFresh launched Factor in Sweden and Denmark in Q1 2024, following prior launches in Australia, Canada, Netherlands, and Belgium.

ai_positioning.summary: HelloFresh makes no mention of strategic artificial intelligence usage in recent communications. Focus is on logistics, supply chain technology, and customer experience, with no reference to generative AI or advanced automation tools.
evidence: No AI mention in Q1 2024 earnings release
No reference to tools such as AI assistants, AI-powered recommendation engines, or AI automation
Focus on tech and data capabilities without specifying AI usage
